"轨迹" (Traject"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"ory) tab: the raw event ledger becomes a storyline anyone can read."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"中文 · Usage · Development"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"The built-in trajectory view is a power tool: untranslated jargon with no legend, five
toolbar toggl"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"es, a zoomable/draggable timeline, a separate inspector, and an event table
that never answers "what"},{"id":"p5s3","text":" did I ask → what did the AI do → what came back". `dsh-trail`
replaces that tab with a storyline de"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"sign — one collapsible card per round,
plain-language tool names, inline argument previews, and guid"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"ance for every state. It
reads only the session snapshot, adds no Host half, and uninstalling restor"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"es the
original view."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Turn cards** — one card per round: what you asked → what the AI thought → which
tools it called "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"→ the outcome, with duration, model and token meta when present.
- **Plain-language tool labels** — "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"`read` renders as *读取文件 (read a file)* with a
one-line note; unknown tools fall back gracefully.
- *"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"*Inline argument previews** — the touched file or command is visible on the row;
raw arguments, resu"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"lts, timing and error metadata fold into a Details toggle.
- **Category filter** — 全部 (all) plus eig"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"ht row categories, combinable and
remembered across sessions.
- **Fuzzy search** — ignores case, pun"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"ctuation and full-width forms; multi-word terms
match as ordered subsequences.
- **Live round** — da"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"shed card with status pills (thinking / generating / running
tool · elapsed) and a spinner; duration"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"s are never fabricated.
- **Zero product coupling** — renders purely from top-level session snapshot"},{"id":"p7s10","text":" fields;
no Host half, no new data endpoints."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Screenshots"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"The Friendly Trajectory view inside the official Web GUI — turn cards summarize each
round, and reas"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"oning, tool arguments and full replies stay folded until expanded:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Restart the profile and open any session: the 轨迹 tab is now the storyline view. The
bundle disables "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"the shipped `ui-trajectory` row and mounts this view in its place, so
exactly one 轨迹 tab remains."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"To go back to the original view:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Update"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Upgrades are never applied automatically; restart the profile afterwards. Two pnpm
behaviors can mak"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"e an update look stale right after a release: the registry metadata
cache and the 24-hour `minimumRe"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"leaseAge` supply-chain policy for freshly published
versions. If `update` reports "Already up to dat"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"e" while npm shows a newer version,
clear the cache (`pnpm cache delete dsh-trail`) or pin explicitl"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"y
(`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-trail@<version> dsh-trail-bundle`)."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Open a conversation and click 轨迹. Read it top-down as a story: expand any folded
reasoning or reply "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"with 展开, and open 详情 on a tool row for raw arguments, results,
timing and tokens. Use the search box"},{"id":"p19s3","text":" to jump to a file or command, and the category bar
to isolate e.g. only 工具 rows — both stay applied"},{"id":"p19s4","text":" or command, and the category bar
to isolate e.g. only 工具 rows — both stay applied while you browse."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"One repository, two npm packages. `dsh-trail` is the client plugin: it registers the
`conversation.v"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"iew` slot cell `id: 'trajectory'` and renders purely from top-level
session snapshot selectors (`nod"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"es`, `turnTimings`, `partial`, `runningCalls`,
`hasMore`, `loadingOlder`, `openState`). `dsh-trail-b"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"undle` is a patch bundle whose
`cordis.patch.yml` inserts the plugin row and sets `disabled: true` o"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"n the shipped

worki"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"ng docs (not shipped with the package)."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Known Limitations and Deferred Work"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- **Web GUI only** — the plugin targets the web shell (`react` ^18 peer dependency);

- **Simplified Chinese-first** — the v1 view copy (labels, tool names, guidance) is"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"
简体中文; an English locale is deferred.

(`nodes`/`turnTimings`/`partial`/`runningCalls`/…), tested against dsh 0.1.0-rc.5;
it mu"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"st be upgraded if the product removes those fields.

so round boundaries are inferred from node order and may occasi"},{"id":"p23s7","text":"onally be drawn wrong.
